source: Kandal Provincial Department of Agriculture (មន្ទីរកសិកម្មខេត្តកណ្តាល), "ដំណំពោត" (Corn Crop / Zea mays production manual), 2015
text:
Seed rot (ជម្ងឺរលួយគ្រាប់ពោត, Seed Rot): this disease is caused by several fungal and bacterial pathogens including Pythium, Fusarium, diplodia, Rhizoctonia, and Penicillium species. Symptoms of this disease are that the seed rots quickly and softens even before it has a chance to germinate above ground.

Prevention and control measures:
- Do not sow seed that has already been damaged or is of poor quality.
- Avoid planting seed before rain.
- Soak/treat seed with water containing a suitable fungicide before sowing.
- Select seed lots that have been tested and certified pure.
